goal: Research current AI narration and text-to-speech providers for the existing 12:30 ontology educational video, then produce an exact-bound comparison, a shortlist of at most three providers to audition, and a reproducible blind-audition plan. Do not claim a voice-quality winner without generated waveform evidence from the fixed script excerpt.
context: The approved text package is a 1,543-word English script for one reflective solo narrator at about 120-130 words per minute, synchronized to eight image worlds and 89 caption cues. The research must separate documented capability, production workflow, price, commercial rights, privacy, data retention, and voice-cloning consent from subjective voice fit; current official sources are required for volatile claims. Research only: no account creation, purchase, credentials, script upload, API call, voice cloning, audio generation, provider commitment, public publication, or video-production claim is authorized.
anti_bias_global: A credible provider shortlist must survive disagreement between feature appeal, owner and data-risk constraints, reproducible production fit, and reviewer attacks against inherited choices, vacuous evidence, and collapsed evaluation criteria.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 runs an empirical comparison of current official product and API documentation while agent 1 runs an adversarial review of official terms, privacy, security, retention, commercial-use, and cloning-consent sources on the methodology and source-corpus axes; a bias in agent 0 toward expressive features and easy integration would be exposed by agent 1 when the rights or data posture is unclear, while a bias in agent 1 toward categorical risk rejection would be exposed by agent 0 when official controls materially constrain that risk.

Agent 0 runs an empirical provider-capability landscape while agent 2 runs a computational production-fit analysis against the exact 12:30 script, caption, pacing, and edit fixture on the methodology and source-corpus axes; a bias in agent 0 toward marketing breadth would be exposed by agent 2 when a capability cannot support a reproducible long-form edit, while a bias in agent 2 toward the current fixture would be exposed by agent 0 when a documented workflow offers a materially better production path.

Agent 1 runs an adversarial owner-rights and data-governance review while agent 2 runs a computational audition, timing, and caption-alignment design using local production artifacts on the methodology and source-corpus axes; a bias in agent 1 toward policy text alone would be exposed by agent 2 when the provider cannot produce an editable witness, while a bias in agent 2 toward audible and operational convenience would be exposed by agent 1 when the workflow requires unsafe uploads, ambiguous rights, or undocumented cloning consent.

agents.angle: Empirical modern-only comparison of official TTS product, model, API, language, voice-control, pronunciation, timing, format, limit, availability, and pricing documentation across a bounded provider landscape.
agents.initial_prompt: Research the current technical landscape for AI narration and text-to-speech providers suitable for a 12:30 English educational video with one reflective solo narrator at 120-130 words per minute. Start from, but do not limit yourself to, the official sources for OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Microsoft Azure AI Speech, Google Cloud Text-to-Speech, Amazon Polly, Cartesia, PlayHT, WellSaid, Hume, and other clearly relevant current candidates; cap the substantive comparison at eight providers. Use only current first-party product, API, model, language, quota, pricing, and status documentation for load-bearing facts. For every provider return exact URL, page title, source-local heading or structured selector, retrieval date, claim scope, and observed or unverified status. Separate documented technical capability from marketing audio quality and do not infer naturalness from samples you did not blind-test. Time-scope pricing and show assumptions instead of normalizing incomparable plans. Return a structured capability matrix, exclusions, unknowns, and at most five technically viable candidates for synthesis. Do not create accounts, use credentials, upload the script, call APIs, generate audio, or mutate files. Inventory effect: the local Inventory has no provider decision, so current official-source discovery is required. Output target about 3200 tokens.

agents.angle: Adversarial modern-only review of official commercial rights, acceptable-use, voice-cloning consent, privacy, training use, retention, deletion, regional, security, and enterprise-control sources.
agents.initial_prompt: Research the rights and data-governance posture of current AI narration and text-to-speech providers for a commercial or public educational video. Begin with the same bounded candidate landscape as the technical lane, but narrow or exclude providers when official evidence is missing. Use only current first-party terms, privacy notices, acceptable-use or safety policies, voice-cloning or consent policies, security documentation, DPA or enterprise-control pages, and official pricing or licensing terms for load-bearing facts. For every claim return exact URL, page title, source-local heading or structured selector, retrieval date, jurisdiction or plan scope where stated, and observed or unverified status. Keep commercial-use rights, generated-audio ownership, input or output training, retention, deletion, voice-clone consent, impersonation controls, and enterprise commitments separate. Absence of official evidence is unknown, not permission. Return hard gates, risk tiers, exclusions, and questions that would require provider confirmation before production. Do not create accounts, accept terms, purchase, use credentials, upload voice or script data, synthesize audio, or give legal advice. Inventory effect: no repository-owned provider policy exists, so the findings must remain a time-scoped research aid rather than authority. Output target about 3200 tokens.

agents.angle: Computational production-fit analysis using the exact local narration, production-script, caption, and validation fixtures plus official workflow documentation to design a falsifiable blind audition.
agents.initial_prompt: Design the smallest reproducible production and listening test for selecting a voice provider for the existing ontology educational video. Read the exact local files research/2026-08-03-ontology-authority-agent-context-presentation/educational-video-voiceover.md, educational-video-production-script.md, educational-video-audition.md, educational-video-captions.vtt, and educational-video-validation.md. Use current official provider workflow or API documentation only when making provider-specific claims. Derive one fixed 75-120 second audition excerpt that exercises reflective warmth, the word approved, a question, time-confidence-authority distinctions, acronyms or product names, and the ask-or-stop cadence without altering the approved words. Specify fixed generation settings, chunking, pronunciation handling, output format, loudness-normalization assumptions, caption or word-timing checks, anonymized file naming, randomized blind order, a scoring rubric, disqualifiers, and how to preserve raw outputs. Keep subjective voice fit distinct from editability, latency, cost, rights, and privacy. Return which documented capabilities are prerequisites, an executable audition protocol, and what remains impossible to know until audio is rendered. Do not upload anything, call an API, generate audio, or edit files. Inventory effect: the 12:30 text package is the evaluation fixture and desk research cannot prove naturalness. Output target about 3400 tokens.

Reconcile the three explorer returns into an exact-bound candidate comparison. Preserve every material disagreement and unknown. Produce: a hard-requirements table; a time-stamped matrix of no more than eight providers; explicit exclusions; a desk-research shortlist of at most three providers for audition; cost arithmetic with assumptions; and the fixed blind-audition protocol. Do not name a voice-quality winner without rendered audio evidence. Every load-bearing row must carry an immutable official source identity, exact source-local selector, explorer-return reference, evidence scope, and observed, executed, or unverified proof status. Where a reviewer could add or change a required positive row, flag the row for the declared explorer-feedback edge. The local Inventory packet is discovery only and must not be cited as provider authority. Output target about 4000 tokens.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 attacks precedent by searching for an already-owned repository provider decision while agent 1 attacks non-vacuity by demanding a reproducible fixed-excerpt audition witness on the attack-vector axis; a bias in agent 0 toward preserving an inherited choice would be exposed by agent 1 when that choice cannot produce a comparable test, while a bias in agent 1 toward rebuilding the decision would be exposed by agent 0 when an existing owner or accepted constraint already controls it.

Agent 0 attacks precedent and ownership while agent 2 attacks definitional collapse among capability, quality, cost, rights, privacy, and consent on the attack-vector axis; a bias in agent 0 toward treating any prior mention as a decision would be exposed by agent 2 when the mention uses provider or quality language imprecisely, while a bias in agent 2 toward conceptual purity would be exposed by agent 0 when repository ownership materially narrows the choice.

Agent 1 attacks non-vacuity through a concrete blind-audition and timing witness while agent 2 attacks definitional soundness of the comparison dimensions on the attack-vector axis; a bias in agent 1 toward a smooth audible demo would be exposed by agent 2 when the rubric hides rights, privacy, or uncertainty inside one score, while a bias in agent 2 toward perfectly separated categories would be exposed by agent 1 when no finite production decision can be made.

agents.angle: Precedent attack that verifies whether the repository, video package, Inventory, memory notes, or an identified owner already selected or constrained a narration provider, and labels any real owner without turning silence into precedent-clean proof.
agents.initial_prompt: Attack the synthesized comparison on the precedent gate. Search the repository and current Inventory for an already-owned narration-provider choice, vendor contract, voice requirement, language or accent requirement, privacy boundary, production-system constraint, or accepted prior result. Verify direct source bytes; Inventory and memory are only leads. Classify a real owner as build-from-owned or already-deployed and explain its binding scope. If nothing is found, report the actual searches and a bounded precedent-clean result rather than inferring ownership from absence. Also check whether the synthesis quietly treats a provider mention, approved voice style, Runway handoff, or text package as a provider decision. Return PASS or exact repair requests with source selectors. Do not edit files or research provider marketing. Output target about 1800 tokens.

agents.angle: Non-vacuity attack requiring each surviving provider to support a documented, reproducible fixed-excerpt audition and requiring the final decision to remain deferred until comparable audio evidence exists.
agents.initial_prompt: Attack the synthesized comparison on the non-vacuity gate. Require the smallest concrete witness: one exact 75-120 second excerpt from the frozen voiceover; reproducible generation settings; pronunciation and chunk controls; comparable output format; anonymized randomized listening; timing and caption checks; separate hard gates and scored preferences; and retained raw artifacts. For each shortlisted provider, verify that official documentation supports a route to this witness without inventing features. KILL a provider-audition candidate if it cannot support the witness or if required capability, rights, consent, or privacy evidence is absent and cannot be repaired through the declared explorer-feedback edge. Do not mistake desk research, vendor demos, or a written test plan for audible quality evidence. Return PASS or exact repair requests with evidence rows affected. Do not edit files or generate audio. Output target about 2000 tokens.

agents.angle: Definitional-soundness attack against collapsing documented capability, production fit, subjective voice quality, price, commercial rights, privacy, retention, security, voice identity, consent, and final owner choice.
agents.initial_prompt: Attack the synthesized comparison on the definitional-soundness gate. Verify that it does not collapse: TTS availability into long-form suitability; marketing expressiveness into blind-tested voice quality; generated-audio ownership into commercial-use permission; security claims into privacy or retention guarantees; custom voice into authorized cloning; low unit price into total production cost; API timestamps into caption accuracy; or a desk shortlist into final provider approval. Require explicit unknown and not-applicable states, time-scoped prices and policies, and a final operator listening decision. A category that merely renames another or a composite best-provider score that hides hard gates is tautological and must be killed or repaired. Return PASS or exact repair requests with evidence rows affected. Do not edit files. Output target about 2000 tokens.

Write findings.md only after exact-binding evidence closure returns ready. Produce a concise decision aid with: research boundary and retrieval date; hard gates; provider comparison with exact official citations and explicit unknowns; typed exclusions; shortlist of at most three providers for audition; time-scoped cost arithmetic; the fixed excerpt and reproducible blind-audition protocol; a verdict matrix with owner, witness, soundness, and verdict; and a clear statement that no voice-quality winner, account action, audio render, or completed video has been established. Cite explorer return references for every load-bearing claim. Do not write research.md, modify the existing video package, or create provider accounts or media. Output target about 4200 tokens.

Audit findings.md only against the frozen goal and exact-binding closure. Recommend accept only if the comparison is current and official-source-bound, every provider row separates capability, production fit, voice quality, price, rights, privacy, retention, and consent, no unknown is converted into permission, the shortlist contains at most three audition candidates, the fixed-excerpt protocol is reproducible, the verdict matrix is complete, and the result does not declare a voice-quality winner or imply audio/video production. Return exact repair requests through the one declared writer-revision edge; missing provider evidence belongs to the explorer-feedback route and cannot be repaired by prose. Output target about 2400 tokens.
